observations: Photo 0: Stack of used wooden pallets outdoors on dirt ground with trash; white labels on some blocks; one pallet lies flat in foreground.
Photo 1: Same stack; oval stamps resembling EPAL visible on several blocks; vehicles and building in background.
Photo 2: Close-up of stacked pallets; clear EPAL oval stamps on multiple blocks; wood appears weathered.
Photo 3: Close-up of a wooden crate or pallet side with vertical slats; no readable brand or model.

claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1, 2, and 3 all show wooden construction.
EPAL stamps visible in photo 1 and photo 2 suggest European origin, but origin of every pallet is not proven.

risks.risk: Some pallets may be cracked, broken, or rotted; photos show only exterior faces.
risks.proof: Video clip panning across every pallet in the stack showing all sides and ends.

risks.risk: Heat treatment / ISPM 15 stamp may be missing; required for some uses.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of HT stamp on representative pallets.

risks.risk: Exact quantity in the lot is unclear from stacked photos.
risks.proof: Wide shot or video showing the full stack with countable units.

risks.risk: Contamination from oil, chemicals, or pests in the dirty yard.
risks.proof: Close-up inspection of pallet surfaces and undersides.
risks.if_unproven: priced as contaminated or requiring cleaning

proof_requests: Video clip panning across the full stack to count pallets and show condition of all sides.
Close-up photos of EPAL and HT stamps on multiple pallets.
Close-up inspection of pallet undersides and slats for cracks, rot, or contamination.
response.reason: The item is clearly a used wooden pallet lot; even at worst case (damaged, untreated, unknown quantity), it can be priced as a pallet lot.
